## Government Service Navigator v2.0.0

Version 2 turns the navigator into a hosted, AI-assisted service platform. Citizens can plan, check, book, pay for and track government services from the mobile app, and officers and administrators run the whole workflow from the web dashboard and Windows app.

### Highlights

- **Four AI agents** guide every application, from understanding what the citizen needs to a final safety check before an officer decides.
- **Online payments** with Stripe, bank deposit slips, installment plans and refunds.
- **Collection slots and bookings** with live capacity, holidays, a daily timeline and postal tracking.
- **Hosted on Azure** as a Docker container, with the web dashboard on Vercel.

### Agentic AI

- **Intake Planning Agent** turns a citizen's plain-language request into a matched service plan (Groq LLM).
- **Eligibility and Document Agent** checks eligibility rules, lists the required documents and inspects uploads with a live AI document inspector and statutory preview.
- **Action and Booking Agent** books collection appointments from natural language, respecting department working hours and slot capacity.
- **Validation and Safety Agent** applies LLM guardrails and PII redaction, writes an officer briefing, compiles the case dossier, routes the case to the right queue and drafts the determination order.
- Knowledge documents feed a vector database (pgvector) for policy-aware answers.

### Web dashboard and Windows app

- Department management for system admins, with a two-officer minimum before a department can go active.
- Service catalog, eligibility rule builder and simulator, and per-service configuration (documents, fees, workflow, knowledge).
- Application form template builder and email template builder.
- Stage-based verification workflow with decisions, rejection codes, bulk verification and department-scoped verified records.
- Finance dashboard with payment sync, deposit slip preview, installment plans and refunds.
- Collection slot management with a real-time daily timeline, working hours, holidays and archived appointments.
- New Government Service Sri Lanka logo and favicon.

### Mobile app

- Search and category filters for services.
- Redesigned eligibility check with AI document inspection.
- Natural-language appointment booking and appointment passes.
- Stage payments, document uploads, saved drafts and real-time application status.
- Postal delivery option with tracking.

### Backend and performance

- Redis-backed caching (HybridCache), token revocation and a SignalR backplane for real-time updates.
- Request validation across all frontend forms and backend endpoints.
- Per-user rate limiting.

### Hosting

- The backend and agentic AI ship as one Docker image, built by GitHub Actions, stored in Azure Container Registry and run on Azure App Service.
- API: `https://gsn-api-dpa2agb6c5h7gyar.southeastasia-01.azurewebsites.net`
- The web dashboard supports client-side routes on Vercel, so pages no longer return 404 after sign-in or on refresh.

### Breaking changes

- **Web:** the API address is now set with `BASE_URL` (replaces `VITE_API_URL`). Production builds use `web/.env.production`.
- **Mobile:** the app now uses the hosted API by default. To use a local backend, run with `--dart-define=API_URL=http://localhost:5119` (or `http://10.0.2.2:5119` on the Android emulator).
- **Backend:** the API listens on `ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS` / `ASPNETCORE_URLS` when set (port 8080 in Docker) and on 5119 otherwise.
- **Backend configuration:** new settings `GROQ_API_KEY`, `GROQ_MODEL`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and `SMTP_*`, plus optional `REDIS_URL`. See `backend/src/.env.example`.
